plan.title: Audit the math, as a specialist agent
Audit the permissions, as a specialist agent
Audit the economics, as a specialist agent
Audit the control flow, as a specialist agent
Judge the audit: reproduce, merge and rank what was found

facts.label: What each contract does
facts.example: e.g. a vault: deposit ETH, withdraw after a lock

facts.label: Who can call what
facts.assumed: Assumed: an owner who can change settings, and anyone for everything else.
facts.example: e.g. only the owner sets the fee; anyone deposits

facts.label: Numbers the contracts enforce
facts.assumed: The builders will choose limits, ratios and durations and write them in the README. Fee rates and prices they will not choose: name them.
facts.example: e.g. 0.3% fee, 7-day lock, max 10 ETH per wallet

facts.label: Upgrades and pausing
facts.assumed: Assumed: not upgradeable and not pausable.
facts.example: e.g. not upgradeable; owner can pause

facts.label: Outside services and values
facts.example: e.g. Chainlink VRF subscription 1234, or: the owner sets the feed after launch

facts.label: Who receives fees and payouts
facts.assumed: Assumed: the launch's owner, the wallet that pays.
facts.example: e.g. 0x1f9a…c3e2, or: the wallet that pays

facts.label: Minting after launch
facts.assumed: Assumed: a fixed supply that nobody can mint more of.
facts.example: e.g. fixed supply, nobody mints more

facts.label: Transfer rules
facts.assumed: Assumed: plain transfers with no fee or limit.
